Coniunctum Corpora

Director · VR developer · Conceptual designerResearch2023

An immersive audiovisual installation: wearing a headset, participants enter a cave-like structure that evokes the inside of the human body. It explores bodily hybridization, the meeting of diverse corporealities and social emotions.
